{{Quote|You were a stormtrooper?''"<br />"''Yeah, but I couldn't stand taking orders, so I jumped ship first chance I got.|Mercenary and the former stormtrooper|<ref name="Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy">''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Jedi Academy]]''</ref>}}
A '''rebellious [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]]''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who worked for the [[Sith cult/Legends|Sith cult]] known as the [[Disciples of Ragnos]]. He was a former [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who hated taking orders, so he left without any notice when he had the chance. He was possibly killed by [[Jaden Korr]] during the [[Mission to Chandrila]].
